headline: Executive order creates a way for alumni of three State Department-backed study abroad programs to be hired into regular federal jobs.
what_it_does: This order sets up a path for people who completed the Fulbright U.S. Student Program, the Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship Program, or the Critical Language Scholarship Program to be appointed to the competitive service. The competitive service covers most regular federal civil service jobs, which usually require going through a standard competitive hiring process. The title does not give details such as time limits or eligibility rules.

who_it_affects.group: Alumni of the Fulbright U.S. Student, Gilman, and Critical Language Scholarship programs
who_it_affects.how: They gain a special pathway to be appointed to competitive service federal jobs.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that hire for competitive service jobs
who_it_affects.how: They are given authority to appoint these program alumni through this pathway.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 29, 2016; the title does not state a separate start date.
